task: B-07 (Lane B; plan ID M2-05; directive D-090)
address: 215-10 and 215-16 Northern Boulevard, Queens (borough 4, block 7334, tax lots 1 and 70)
purpose: Recorded official city data for multi-lot site math on the benchmark block: tax lot 1's MapPLUTO outline and PLUTO row, and the DCM street center lines around lots 1 + 70. Tax lot 70's records are in ../benchmark_215_16_northern (queue item B-01). DOB BIS job 421803891 (in that pack) is a filing that mentions one zoning lot of tax lots 1 and 70; it is evidence of a filing, not a verified zoning lot.
authentication: none (keyless official services and anonymous NYC Open Data SODA reads; no credential exists in this pack)
capture_method: Python urllib GET with 'Accept: application/json', one request per file, sequential with a >= 2.5 s pause, 2026-10-01 UTC, by the Lane B B-07 producer. Bodies stored byte-for-byte as returned. Every URL was produced by the named connector's own URL builder (field 'connector').
retrieved_at_basis: client UTC clock when the request was sent; 'http_date' is the response Date header
digest_algorithm: sha256 hex over the exact file bytes (= the response body bytes). The directory's .gitattributes sets '-text' so no line-ending conversion ever changes them.
capture_notes: All four requests returned HTTP 200 on the first attempt.

files.purpose: Tax lot 1 outline in EPSG:2263 feet (the measurement geometry) and its MapPLUTO Version.
PLUTO row for tax lot 1: lotarea / lotfront / lotdepth (City records) and zoning districts.

files.connector: app.connectors.dcm_street_centerline_arcgis.build_segment_query_url(envelope=(1048541.85, 216138.42, 1049061.58, 216581.1)) - the union of the MapPLUTO bounds of lots 1 and 70 (0.01 ft) padded by 150 ft (app.spatial.site_geometry.parameters.SEARCH_RADIUS_FT)
files.purpose: Every DCM street center line within 150 ft of the combined lots 1 + 70.
DCM layer metadata: editingInfo.dataLastEditDate (dataset version for street widths, B-04).
